query: SELECT c.relname::text AS "relation?", a.attname::text AS "column?", pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) AS "grantor!", CASE WHEN acl.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END AS "grantee!", acl.privilege_type AS "privilege!", acl.is_grantable AS "grant_option!" FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode( COALESCE(a.attacl, acldefault('c'::"char", c.relowner))) acl WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = ANY($2::text[]) AND a.attnum > 0
